content.title: Small team jam
content.summary: Teams make a small project and share progress before a review round.
content.setup: Divide participants into at least two teams and choose the work and review deadlines.
content.prompt: Make a tiny interactive story about an unexpected journey.
content.participant: Work with your team. Share progress with your team or the whole group, then submit one final project. Review another team after the work deadline.
content.completion: Read the final projects and the revealed reviews.
content.access: All work and reviews use text in this package. Teams may work offline between updates.

provenance.rights: Illustrative package content; reuse terms have not been specified.
